sources_considered.why: The ARC Prize Foundation's own results, dated 5 December 2025, with verified scores of the best AI systems on ARC-AGI-2.
The ARC-AGI-2 paper (May 2025) reports the human testing of every task.
ARC Prize 2025 technical report, January 2026. Its abstract adds no figure the results page lacks.
Abstract page only; the figures are in the PDF.

receipt.public_excerpt: As of today, the top verified commercial model, Opus 4.5 (Thinking, 64k), scores 37.6% for $2.20/task. The top verified refinement solution, built on Gemini 3 Pro and authored by Poetiq, scores 54% for $30/task.

evidence_items.explanation: On 5 December 2025 the best verified AI systems solved 37.6% (a commercial model) and 54% (a refinement system) of ARC-AGI-2 tasks. No verified system solved the set in full.

receipt.public_excerpt: 100% of ARC-AGI-2 tasks were solved by at least two people (many were solved by more) in two attempts or less.

evidence_items.explanation: Every ARC-AGI-2 task was solved by at least two people in two attempts or less. With the December 2025 AI scores, this shows reasoning work that people do and that no verified AI system did in full.
